finalText:
**Build is clean.** Exit 0, `0 errors`, just the expected 8 deprecation warnings.

Two real bugs in the link stage, both from the bundler bump:

- [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
- [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) threw on `undefined` backoff flags. The new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`, so I made `undefined` mean disabled.

The rest was deprecation noise (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, punycode, etc), harmless.

No further action needed.
